text.p: Magnum Petroleum Inc said Friday it has received a new commitment from Wells Fargo Bank, Banque Paribas and First Union Corp of North Carolina for an increase in the company's senior credit facility.

The company said the borrowing base on its revolving credit facility has been increased to $55 million from $40 million. The company's term loan of $8 million obtained in June 1996, used to fund a portion of the acquisition of the the "Panoma" properties from Burlington Resources Inc has been eliminated.
The revolving credit facility continues to give the company the flexibility to choose a range of either "LIBOR" or "Prime" based interest rates options, Magnum noted.

"We are very pleased to have received a commitment from a new bank, First Union Corp of North Carolina, which brings additional "financial muscle" to the current energy lending institutions in our senior bank group," Magnum said.
